title: Agon: An Autonomous Large-Scale Omnidisciplinary Research System Built on Prompt Economy
abstract: arXiv:2606.24177v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language models are making research scalable. We present \textsc{Agon}, a research orchestrator designed to probe the limits of automated research. \textsc{Agon} is built on six design principles: Prompt Economy, Future-Facing, Minimal Prompts, OmniDisciplinary, Massive Parallelism, and Zero-Code. We deployed \textsc{Agon} across domains using only brief topic descriptions as starting points and no human-written code. These deployments demonstrate scalability but also reveal previously unseen classes of failure that are difficult to address through prompt engineering. We organize these failures into a taxonomy along four dimensions: severity, fixability, visibility, and capability locus. Together, these results show that \textsc{Agon} is pushing research towards a new paradigm: machines scale, humans steer. Our code is publicly available at \href{https://github.com/AutoResearch-Factory/Agon/tree/lite}{this GitHub reposito

translated_title: Agon：一个基于提示经济学构建的自主大规模全学科研究系统
translated_abstract: 大语言模型正在使研究变得可扩展。我们提出了Agon，一个旨在探索自动化研究极限的研究编排系统。Agon建立在六项设计原则之上：提示经济学、面向未来、最少提示、全学科覆盖、大规模并行和零代码。我们在多个领域部署了Agon，仅使用简短的主题描述作为起点，且未使用任何人工编写的代码。这些部署展示了系统的可扩展性，但同时也揭示了此前未曾见过的故障类别，这些故障难以通过提示工程加以解决。我们将这些故障按照严重程度、可修复性、可见性和能力定位四个维度组织成一个分类体系。这些结果共同表明，Agon正在推动研究走向一种新的范式：机器负责扩展，人类负责掌舵。我们的代码已在GitHub上公开。
tldr: Agon是一个基于提示经济学原则构建的全自主大规模跨学科研究编排系统，通过零代码部署展示了“机器扩展、人类掌舵”的新研究范式，并首次提出了自动化研究故障的四维分类体系。
en_tdlr: Agon is an autonomous large-scale omnidisciplinary research orchestrator built on prompt economy principles, demonstrating a new "machines scale, humans steer" paradigm through zero-code deployments and introducing a four-dimensional taxonomy of previously unseen automated research failures.
